findings.title: X-Data-Source Header Implementation Gap
findings.problem: Design acknowledges NestJS header control limitation but provides incomplete workaround. States 'include in response body' instead of fulfilling requirement to set X-Data-Source HTTP header.
findings.impact: Frontend cannot distinguish stale data via HTTP headers; breaks design contract for header-based behavior.
findings.fix: Specify header mechanism explicitly using @Header() decorator, interceptor, or middleware. Document concrete implementation pattern.

findings.title: Search Results Caching Consistency Undefined
findings.problem: Requirements state search results cached 1 hour per query string; design states 'no caching at this level' for CricketDataService. Neither PlayerStatsService nor LiveMatchService handles search caching.
findings.impact: Search endpoint will not respect 1-hour TTL and query-based cache keys; implementation team must invent own strategy.
findings.fix: Either add SearchResultsService with 1-hour TTL and query-hashed cache keys, or clarify search is not cached and update requirements.

findings.title: Admin Cache Invalidation Endpoints Missing
findings.problem: Design mentions admin endpoint DELETE /v1/admin/cricket-data/cache/{cacheType}/:key but provides no implementation. Marked as 'future phase' but API endpoints are Phase M scope.
findings.impact: No manual invalidation mechanism for stale cached data. Users must wait up to 1 hour for fixes.
findings.fix: Either add complete admin endpoint implementation (controller, service, authorization, audit log) or explicitly move cache invalidation to Out of Scope.

findings.title: ProviderError Class Violates Project Error Pattern
findings.problem: Design introduces custom ProviderError class instead of using project standard AppException with ErrorCode enum. Violates AGENTS.md mandate for consistent error codes.
findings.impact: Error handling is fragmented; monitoring/logging of error codes incomplete. Future modules will not know which pattern to follow.
findings.fix: Change ProviderError to extend AppException with ErrorCode values, or keep as data class and throw AppException directly in controller.

findings.title: Financial/Currency Strategy Unspecified for Integer-Minor-Unit Requirement
findings.location: PlayerStatsDto DTOs with numeric fields (runs, battingAverage, strikeRate)
findings.problem: AGENTS.md mandates never use floating-point for money; design does not specify if stats floats are display-only or could propagate into financial calculations.
findings.impact: If stats floats are used in future bid-increment calculations, floating-point will propagate into financial operations, violating mandate.
findings.fix: Clarify in design that stats DTOs are display-only floats; monetary values will use integer minor units in auction module.

findings.title: Rate Limiter Thread-Safety Assumption
findings.problem: Simple array filtering is not thread-safe. Concurrent requests may both see same window state and exceed maxRequests limit.
findings.impact: Rate limiter may not enforce limits correctly under concurrent load.
findings.fix: Add note documenting single-instance suitability. For distributed systems, recommend Redis-based rate limiting or add concurrency lock.

findings.title: Search Results Response Schema Inconsistency
findings.location: Requirements 3.1 response schema vs controller implementation
findings.problem: total field computed as results.length, not from provider. If provider limits results, total will show 20 (not 1000) even if provider has more matches.
findings.impact: Clients cannot determine if more results are available; frontend shows incorrect totals.
findings.fix: Either add totalMatches/hasMore to PlayerSearchResult DTO, or clarify that total is returned items count, not provider database total.

findings.title: Cache Key Collision Risk with Multiple Providers
findings.problem: Design allows multiple providers in future but cache keys do not namespace by provider. Stats from ESPN could be returned for cricapi queries.
findings.impact: Silent data inconsistency if multiple providers used with same player IDs.
findings.fix: Include provider name in cache keys: cricket:stats:{providerName}:{playerId}

findings.title: forceRefresh Logic Ambiguity in PlayerStatsService
findings.problem: forceRefresh=true bypasses cache on read and updates on success, but on error leaves stale cache untouched. Ambiguous behavior creates inconsistency.
findings.impact: Stale data may be returned on next call without forceRefresh if initial forceRefresh failed during outage.
findings.fix: Explicitly document: either 'return stale on forceRefresh failure' or 'return error on forceRefresh failure'.

findings.title: LiveMatchService 15-Minute TTL May Be Outdated During Live Matches
findings.problem: Live matches update every 10–30 seconds; 15-minute cache serves extremely stale data (scores, wickets, status outdated).
findings.impact: Live match information will be significantly delayed, violating freshness requirement.
findings.fix: Reduce TTL to 2–5 minutes for live matches, or document separate handling for live vs completed/scheduled matches.

findings.title: ZodValidationPipe Error Response Format Unspecified
findings.problem: Design does not specify HTTP status or response body format when Zod validation fails (e.g., missing required query param).
findings.impact: Frontend cannot reliably handle validation errors; uncertain error response shape.
findings.fix: Add note: 'Zod validation errors caught by http-exception.filter.ts; clients expect HTTP 400 with error body containing code and details.'

findings.title: Mock Implementation Requirements for Testing Are Incomplete
findings.location: Testing Strategy section (40+ unit, 15 integration, 5 E2E tests)
findings.problem: Design specifies test counts but not mocking approach: should provider use axios-mock-adapter or real calls? Should Redis use ioredis-mock?
findings.impact: Implementation team guesses at testing strategy; tests may be slow/flaky if mocking not pre-defined.
findings.fix: Add testing section specifying: axios-mock-adapter for provider, ioredis-mock for Redis, concurrent Promise.all() for rate limiter tests.

findings.title: Frontend Hook Missing Error Recovery Mechanism
findings.problem: Hook has no autoRetry or exponential backoff for transient network errors. Only manual refetch() available; will fail immediately if network is still down.
findings.impact: Frontend has no graceful retry; users must manually click 'Retry' or refresh page.
findings.fix: Either add autoRetry parameter with exponential backoff, or document that frontend caller is responsible for retry logic.

summary.decision: 5 HIGH findings require resolution before implementation. Design architecture is sound but contains specification gaps and inconsistencies.
